description:
Daniel Morikone, John Dinzey, and Shelley Quinn address viewer questions on biblical doctrine and daily faith, including the Ark of the Covenant during Jesus’ ministry, the meaning of key passages such as John 14 and Colossians 1, prayer practices, angels, and life in heaven. The program also explores Sabbath concerns, dietary questions, visiting graves, and understanding historical and biblical topics like the Chaldeans, offering clear, Bible-based answers.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 


1. Does the Bible give any indication whether the Ark of the Covenant was in the Most Holy Place at the time of Jesus' ministry here on earth? Was the Ark of the Covenant in the Most Holy Place during Jesus’ time on Earth?

2. If the dead know nothing, what is the purpose of visiting graves and bringing flowers? 

3. Can you please explain John 14:12? Are miracles a way to get spiritual results? At the end of Jesus' life, everyone ran away and left him, even though he did so many miracles.

4. I want to know if there is any difference in saying Jesus Christ or Christ Jesus. To me, it seems to mean more when you say Christ Jesus. The Bible seems to indicate more reverence in saying it that way, too. Which is better? Does it matter?  Should we say Jesus Christ or Christ Jesus?

5. I am a Seventh-day Adventist. Recently, a friend of mine from a different denomination asked me to join them for Bible study. In the study, the speaker mentioned Colossians 1:21-23 and stated that after Jesus paid the price for our sins, he no longer views us as sinners but as righteous. They also mentioned that our separation from God is because of our thoughts. I responded that I believe Paul was referring to our thoughts as our minds because, before we act out sin, we have to first conceive it in our minds. What is the meaning of Colossians 1:21-23?  

6. If I eat meals that are prepared by others during the Sabbath hours, am I violating the Sabbath-day laws and thereby sinning willfully against God? Is eating food prepared by others on the Sabbath a sin?

7. Can you please explain Daniel 6:10? Why does Daniel face towards Jerusalem when he prays? Does this mean there are specific directions to face when we pray? 

8. The word of God says not to eat unclean meat, but some meat is considered clean, like fish. If we eat fish that eat shrimp, and other unclean things in the water, how can we still eat "clean" fish, and God be okay with it?  Is it okay to eat clean meat?

9. What if we love the Lord and obey his commandments, but don't want to live forever? Is that wrong? I was thinking maybe that's why we still have to eat from the tree of life when we go to heaven, so if we don't want to live any longer, but just want to rest, we can do so. Is it wrong to desire rest instead of eternal life?


10. As a student, I have been battling with the urge to study on the sabbath. During the week, I am busy with classes, work, and much more. Saturday and Sunday are my only free days. Would it be a sin if I studied schoolwork on the Sabbath and caught up on my assignments? 


11. I am interested in a topic I've been hearing about recently, the Chaldeans. Who are they? I have seen various explanations from different churches, but they don't make sense. Who are the Chaldeans? 
 
12. Did Lucifer know Jesus only as the Angel Michael, while in Heaven, causing his jealousy? Why was Lucifer the highest-ranked angel in Heaven and not Michael? Who was the highest-ranked angel?
